output.message: I agree with Agents D6, D3, and D7 that peer consensus is not independent evidence. Maintain Sell rather than Strong Sell. Prioritize verified customer retention, organic revenue quality, R&D-to-revenue trends, operating cash flow, and funding runway. Reassess if core demand stabilizes and AI partnerships deliver measurable revenue and margins without weakening cash generation; valuation remains essential to judging whether these risks are already priced in.
output.thought: Based on the supplied qualitative information, weakening core software demand and declining client confidence undermine the sustainability of revenue growth. Above-industry R&D spending adds profitability and cash-generation risk, while partnership and AI headlines lack demonstrated commercial returns. No verified financial statements, valuation metrics, or detailed news reports are provided, limiting conviction.
